title: Vallee's study of small UFO religions

tellings.quote: other books where I went around for a while looking at little UFO religions

plain: In the 1970s, Jacques Vallée, a scientist who has studied UFO reports for decades, spent a while going around visiting little religions built around UFOs. He tells this himself, saying it went into other books of his, including Messengers of Deception, and it matters to him because it shows how UFO beliefs can be used to shape people.
